# ARCHITECTURE

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

Frontend: Next.js App Router (React, TypeScript strict)
Styling: Tailwind CSS
Hosting: Vercel
Backend / Database: none in v1 (Supabase planned later)

## Rendering
- Every page is a statically generated server component (SSG). No runtime data fetching.
- /musicians/[slug] uses generateStaticParams from /content/musicians.ts.

## Content
- All site content lives in /content/*.ts as typed constants:
  - /content/studio.ts — StudioInfo (name, tagline, email, address, socials)
  - /content/musicians.ts — Musician[] with credits
  - /content/about.ts — AboutSection[]
  - /content/festival.ts — Festival with lineup
- Types live in /lib/types.ts. Helper lookups (getMusicianBySlug, etc.) live in /lib/content.ts.
- Images live in /public/images/{musicians,about,festival}/ and render with next/image.

## Contact
mailto:binauanders@gmail.com from /content/studio.ts. No form, no server code.

## Environment Variables
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL (for metadata and Open Graph URLs)
